periods.summary: Stella spends the day sleeping and storing energy after Nene's training. In the final she initially suffers under Ikki's close-range prediction, but reveals her cross-match trap: Dragon Spirit does not require stabbing herself. She melts the ring into lava, pushes Ikki to fear, and clashes with him as an equal rival. Her talent continues to evolve after Ikki's Ittou Shura, apparently surpassing his fate-bound limit, but Ikki returns through awakened will. Stella answers with star-like heat armor and a final thrust, yet Ikki's Oikage cuts her faster than her light can erase Intetsu. She accepts defeat without wasting tears, turns frustration into next year's challenge, deepens her relationship with Ikki, and stands beside him in Kagami's final photo.

periods.summary: Stella celebrates after the Seven Stars Festival, vows to defeat Ikki next time, and later supports him during Ascaride's surprise test. Tsukikage's vision of Tokyo's destruction deeply alarms her as a princess and future protector of her people, but Ikki helps her avoid taking the whole future onto herself alone. She returns to Vermillion with Ikki and is warmly welcomed by the public and family, only to learn that her father and citizens used a manhunt to test Ikki. She breaks down because she wanted Ikki to love her homeland, but Ikki says their love for her made him love Vermillion too. Stella joins him in asking her family to accept their relationship, and she is named among the Vermillion representatives for the coming war.

periods.summary: Stella returns home and watches Sirius repeatedly challenge Ikki. She accompanies Ikki and Lunaeyes to Quedland, where she sees the warmth between both countries and states that she loves and wants to protect Vermillion, Quedland, and their people. Or-Gaule ambushes the gathering, reveals his control over John and Quedland, murders or displays dead representatives, and announces his plan to force the two friendly nations into mutual slaughter. After Alice evacuates Stella to Freyaveg, Stella races to the palace, manifests flame wings for the first time, and tells her parents the truth. She struggles with Astrea's rational military logic until Sirius chooses to save Quedland, renewing Stella's pride in being his daughter. At Caldia she uses Dragon Raiment's phosphorescent sensory field to detect puppet relay nodes, proving she too can free soldiers. She then faces Naseem Salim, resists terror through Ikki's example, analyzes part of his dehydration/sand-like body ability, and is saved from his ultimate escalation by Nene's arrival before Or-Gaule interrupts with Lunaeyes.

key_events.summary: Learns Or-Gaule's motive is pure sadistic amusement and that he has turned Quedland into a weapon against Vermillion.
Brings the truth to the palace and witnesses Sirius choose to save, not kill, Quedland's people.
Finds relay nodes using Dragon Raiment's sensory phosphorescence.
Fights the Desert Reaper, discovers his ability is dehydration, and survives until Nene intervenes.
Is stunned when Lunaeyes appears with Or-Gaule and accepts Quedland's war terms.

periods.summary: Stella is shaken by the eighty-three deaths at Caldia and initially tries to define herself as a sword that must die if necessary for Vermillion. She insists on challenging Edelweiss because ordinary training will only teach her to survive, not to protect. Under Edelweiss's contract she holds Fifth Camp alone for six days, learning from Tatara how to conserve heat, use terrain, and think like a battlefield fighter. When Fu Xiaoli arrives, Stella is beaten down by a copied version of her own dragon power and Chinese martial arts, but she discovers that her true motive is not royal obligation or martyrdom: she wants the people who loved and raised her to be proud of her. Her soul responds; Laevateinn evolves into a larger golden sword and she splits Edelberg to defeat Xiaoli. Back in Vermillion she passes Nene's Desperado pressure, tells Lunaeyes not to sacrifice what she treasures, and lights the funeral pyre while promising to save the nation and John alike.

periods.summary: At the Vermillion funeral wake, Stella joins the people, protects Ikki's homeland food from takoyaki slander, and worries about Nene drinking before battle. After hearing of the League army's disaster against Naseem, she prays for the dead and tells Ikki that she no longer fears Naseem as she once did because the Crimson Princess is supported by her people. Her real fear is Ikki dying; after he vows to return alive, she accepts his kiss and chooses to trust him. At the start of the war, Naseem scatters the team. Stella initially tries to rescue Ikki from the fall, but John attacks on Golden Chariot. Remembering Lunaeyes's plea and trusting Ikki's strength, Stella focuses on John. She recognizes that Or-Gaule's puppet control is forcing John's body past its limits. To end it quickly she dismisses Lævateinn, confronts Trampling King's Road barehanded, and overpowers its fate-breaking charge because John has no true will while puppeteered. Stella drags him off the chariot and delivers Lunaeyes's scolding slap, sending him to the ground. After Lunaeyes personally reaches John and frees him, Stella confirms the rescue, admires her sister's courage, then senses Or-Gaule's thread network over Quedland and flies toward him with renewed anger.

After John is rescued, tracks Or-Gaule's threads and later blocks his escape with dragon fire.

periods.summary: Stella enters the Or-Gaule battle after defeating puppet John, intercepting Or-Gaule's sky escape with Calusaritio Salamander and then coordinating with Alice. Or-Gaule reveals that Lunaeyes secured the representative-war format by promising that, if Vermillion lost, she would personally execute her own family. Stella recognizes the isolation and horror of Lunaeyes's bargain and converts her rage into a vow to burn Or-Gaule completely and cast his remains into the sea. Her improved resolve lets her ignore Or-Gaule's Desperado pressure and fight alongside Alice, repeatedly forcing him into evasions. When Alice unexpectedly protects Or-Gaule and attacks Stella, Stella initially assumes control or mistake, then realizes Alice chose it herself. She prepares to cut Alice down, but Ikki intervenes, arguing that only Stella can catch the airborne Or-Gaule. Stella reluctantly entrusts Alice to Ikki and flies after Or-Gaule, choosing duty and trust over remaining beside him.

periods.summary: Stella pursues Or-Gaule through Luxel's commercial district after Ikki takes Alice. She burns through Deus Ex Machina and severs his city-spanning threads with Calusaritio Salamander. Or-Gaule attempts to shake her trust in Ikki, but Stella declares that Ikki will keep his promise and she only needs to kill Or-Gaule. When he uses Quedland civilians as puppets, Stella's prior preparation brings Sirius, the Vermillion army, League troops, and Norman's Divine Gate into play; she dismembers Or-Gaule and throws him to John, seemingly ending the war. Or-Gaule's Danse Macabre corpse resurrects and strangles her, forcing Ikki to intervene. After Ikki is killed before her eyes and Or-Gaule crushes his head, Stella undergoes Ultra Awakening, grows horns, wings, scales, and a tail, but refuses to regret meeting Ikki. Her anger at Ikki's broken promise and pride in their love keep her mind intact. With Shizuku reviving Ikki and Nene shielding civilians, Stella fights Or-Gaule in her dragonized form. Ikki's delayed Kuruizakura cuts disrupt Or-Gaule's La Grand Guignol, allowing Stella to pierce him with Laevateinn and burn him to ash. She rebukes him for ignoring Alice's love, keeps some ash to bury with Alice, and declares victory. In hospital she reconciles with Ikki after first avoiding him in anger. Later she stops Tatara from leaving, offers her a role as future queen's guard, accepts Tatara's refusal, but receives her true name Fia and contact information, deciding not to give up on reaching her.

periods.summary: Stella undergoes a five-hour examination by Shizuku to determine whether her body permanently changed after entering a negative Brute Soul state against Or-Gaule. The exam finds no present abnormal tissue, unknown structure, genetic change, or loss of female bodily function, relieving Stella's fear that she might no longer be human or able to bear children. She accepts that relying on Transcendent Awakening again could make her unable to return, and resolves to draw out her soul's potential while remaining herself.

She intercepts Douglas Upton's final hadron-cannon shot, refuses to let him kill anyone in the name of justice, and cleaves Enterprise apart with Calusaritio Salamander. During the victory night she reunites with Hagun friends, then shares a domestic, intimate interlude with miniature Ikki: they discuss their future marriage, children and life together. Their peaceful moment is destroyed when an Abraham clone teleports in, incapacitates her with electrokinesis and transfers her to Arlanz, who abducts her for his ultimate-life experiment.

periods.summary: Stella spends much of the volume captive in Eilands' laboratory, drugged inside a tank while Abraham and Eilands rewrite her memories. The false life recasts her childhood fire awakening as a mass-murder tragedy and traps her for seventy subjective years in isolation, weakening her sense that her time with Ikki was real. Eilands only partially succeeds; he possesses her body through Darwin cells, stabs Ikki, destroys the lab with Bahamut Soul and nearly kills the rescue team. After Shizuku sends Ikki into her mind, Ikki recognizes that she still clings to Laevateinn because she has not surpassed him. He attacks with Tsuikage, and Stella's buried rivalry and admiration revive her, letting her parry the blade, reclaim youth and self, and burn out Darwin. After recovery she thanks Edelweiss, learns Eilands' true body has been destroyed, and by October prepares for her wedding to Ikki in Vermillion.

key_events.summary: Eilands imprisons Stella in a tank and starts erasing Crimson Princess through drugged memory rewriting.
Eilands controls Stella's body, stabs Ikki and unleashes Bahamut Soul on the rescuers.
